name: ShipStation
label: ShipStation API V2 — shipments and labels
description: ShipStation API v2 at https://api.shipstation.com. Docs: https://docs.shipstation.com/shipments/create. shipment_create sends official shipments[] (V2 has no sales-order endpoints). label_create sends shipment or rate_id/shipment_id. Auth header API-Key. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log api_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: order_list | shipment_create | label_create | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: shipments
schema.description: Official shipments array for shipment_create (POST /v2/shipments). Each item requires ship_to, packages, and ship_from or warehouse_id. Optional: carrier_id, service_code, items, customs.

schema.label: shipment
schema.description: Label shipment object for label_create (POST /v2/labels) when not using rate_id/shipment_id. Requires carrier_id, service_code, ship_to, ship_from, packages[].weight.

schema.label: rate_id
schema.description: Existing rate id for label_create from a quoted rate.

schema.label: shipment_id
schema.description: Existing shipment id for label_create from a created shipment.

schema.label: validate_address
schema.description: Address validation on label_create. EXACT: no_validation | validate_only | validate_and_clean.

schema.label: label_format
schema.description: label_create format. pdf | png | zpl. Example: pdf.

schema.label: shipment_status
schema.description: order_list filter. pending | processing | label_purchased | cancelled.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: order_list | shipment_create | label_create | trigger. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type header API-Key (docs.shipstation.com/authentication). Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
